comments.body:
rejected: check_fence authorizes only an exact live create_revision. A fence ahead of every live grant is unverified and must fail closed as UNKNOWN; STALE is reserved for a lower absent fence. UNKNOWN is never an OK authorization. A different diagnostic enum may be useful, but returning UNKNOWN here does not authorize a stale or forged grant.

Evidence at PR head 87a1ecb649a8649e55c96849bb9a7c1f34d242dd: handler_lease_fence.py: fence in live -> OK; fence < max(live) -> STALE; otherwise UNKNOWN.
